items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I'd take Gene if he wanted to go and Cutty gladly

ctx.x: Weren't you considered "the" really basic band? The longest time band--

Well, I think the longest time band was probably Edmond Hall and Cutty Cutshall, and Schroeder and Cliff Leeman and we had drums changed all the time. The changes would be between George Wettling and Cliff Leeman and we had several bass players - changes of bass players in there. And, I think Peanuts and Pee Wee Russell - we had those clarinets - changing from time to time. But, I think the best and the most exciting band, of course, was the band-- when we had Cutty Cutshall and---
